Our Story

A pub with a story at its heart

The Bull Inn Pub is a historic country pub near Reading, set in the village of Stanford Dingley, Berkshire, where traditional hospitality, good food, and genuine warmth have been part of daily life for centuries. Dating back to the 15th century, the pub has long been a place for locals and visitors alike to gather, relax, and feel at home.

The Bull Inn is a 15th-century country pub that has been carefully refurbished to preserve its original features while remaining welcoming and comfortable. Inside, you will find details that speak to the building's history, including a wattle and daub wall in the tap room, two open fires, and traditional lounge spaces that invite you to slow down and stay awhile.

Today, the pub is owned and run by Ana Taylor, alongside Head Chef James, who works closely with Ana in the day-to-day running of the business. Our country pub is proudly independent, allowing decisions to be made with care, flexibility, and a clear focus on quality rather than compromise.

Best Sunday Roast in West Berkshire — Reading Chronicle 2023 Winner — Channel 4's Four in a Bed, Season 15, 2025

Food at The Bull Inn

Pub favourites, full of flavour

At The Bull Inn, 80% of our menu is gluten free, giving you plenty of choice when you sit down to eat with us. Our fish and chips are cooked in beef tallow for a crisp finish and rich, traditional flavour.

Menus are built around British favourites, generous portions, and dishes that feel comforting and familiar — and all food is made in-house. If you have any allergies or dietary requirements, please speak to our team before ordering. We'll be happy to help you choose.

The Bar

Beer & cider on tap

Inside, you'll find a spacious, separate bar and taproom featuring Chesterfield chairs, sofas, and open wood-burning fires. We also offer beer suitable for those avoiding gluten, alongside our wider drinks selection.

No. 1

Good Old Boy

A classic bitter brewed with a blend of rich malted barley and fruity hops.

No. 2

Guinness Draught

One of the world's best-loved beers, with sweet-smelling aromas of coffee and malt.

No. 3

Foster's

The ultimate ice-cold refreshment, with a balance of subtle fruitiness and vanilla.

No. 4

Amstel

Our classic, golden Amstel beer, with its very distinctive and mildly bitter taste.

No. 5

Birra Moretti

The ultimate Italian lager since 1859, brewed with a special blend of high-quality hops.

No. 6

Heineken 0.0%

A refreshing alcohol-free beer with fruity, fresh malt notes and a light body.

No. 7

Cruzcampo

A pilsner-style Spanish lager founded in Seville in 1904, brewed with subtle hoppy notes.

No. 8

Inch's Medium Apple Cider

When it comes to making Inch's, it's all about the little things: the craft, the care.

Please note: drinks only on Mondays. We're open for drinks on Wednesdays from 12:00, but the kitchen opens at 17:30. Happy Hour runs all day Wednesday — beers and wines from as little as £4. See our drinks page.

The Garden

Over an acre of countryside calm

With over an acre of outdoor space, our beautiful gardens include a picturesque paddock, a large covered terrace, a cozy sofa area, and our unique outdoor 'Horse-Box Bar.' In the summer, the garden becomes the heart of the pub — ideal for summer lunches, weekend drinks, family gatherings and post-walk refreshments.

One of the defining features of The Bull Inn is our quarter-acre paddock — ideal for weddings, corporate events and family celebrations, or as a breakout area during larger gatherings. In winter, come inside: open fires create a warm and inviting atmosphere in our historic 15th-century building.

  • Quarter-acre paddock
  • Covered terrace & heated patio
  • Horse-Box Bar
  • Children's play area
  • Seasonal bouncy castle
  • Pool table & darts
  • Table tennis & football goals
  • Two open fires

Event Venue · Private Dining

A venue for all occasions

The Bull offers exceptional spaces and ample parking in the heart of Royal Berkshire, making it the ideal venue for any gathering. We provide fully tailored menus and packages designed to suit your taste and budget — rather than fixed packages, we work with you to shape the event around your plans, guest numbers, and budget. We can host smaller private dining groups and larger events up to approximately 80 guests, depending on layout and hire type.

Celebrate with us

Birthdays and anniversaries · Weddings and wedding receptions · Baby showers and christenings · Retirement celebrations · Wakes and memorial gatherings · Corporate meetings and private bookings · Wedding rehearsal dinners · Christmas dining and festive parties.

Your hire options

Within our restaurant — reserve a section, ideal for family milestone birthdays, small corporate dinners and intimate anniversaries.
Exclusive private area hire — dedicated seating, customised table layouts, bespoke menus and drinks.
Full venue hire — exclusive use of the restaurant and bar, with garden and paddock access — particularly popular for weddings, larger celebrations and corporate events.

Seasonal events include race days with cinema screen, open-air cinema evenings, hog roasts, BBQs and paella nights, and live music events.

Stay With Us

Our Rooms

Our recently refurbished rooms, completed in late 2018, offer five spacious and tastefully decorated en-suite accommodations. Each room overlooks our beautiful garden and features Super King Size Double Divan Beds with luxury mattresses. The Bull's garden-view bedrooms each have a private terrace furnished with rattan furniture — located just 9 miles from central Reading and Newbury, 29 miles from Oxford, and only 40 miles from London Heathrow.

Our versatile rooms can easily be converted into 'Twin' rooms and include a convenient lockable internal door, perfect for families. Modern en-suite facilities with shower amenities complete the offering. Our rooms are dog-friendly, too.

Our Double with Shower En-Suite

Tranquil, secure, and rustic yet elegantly designed with comfort and relaxation at the forefront. Our Double Rooms provide a blend of sophistication and comfort, offering plenty of space to unwind. Each en-suite room features a luxurious 2018 Divan King Bed, a 40″ flat-screen Smart TV, and convenient tea and coffee-making facilities.

FanWiFiShowerDrinksToiletries
  • All rooms are non-smoking, with areas to smoke outside.

  • Breakfast is available upon request: £14.95 per person for a full English, £11.95 for continental breakfast.

Christmas at The Bull

Make Christmas Day special

Good food, familiar faces and time together around the table. Celebrate Christmas Day 2026 at The Bull Inn with a delicious five-course meal, planned with gluten-free options in mind. Bring the family, settle in and let us take care of the cooking — and don't forget your most wonderfully terrible Christmas jumper: our ugly Christmas jumper competition is on, with a bottle of Champagne for the winning table!

£125 per adult  ·  £55 per child

One sitting between 12.30pm and 1.30pm. A non-refundable deposit is required when booking. Tables are limited, so please get in touch to reserve yours — and let us know about any dietary requirements when booking. Our festive set menu is also available throughout December: 3 for £30, perfect for work parties and festive lunches.

Dogs & Family

No outing is complete without them

At the Bull, we believe no outing is complete without your furry friends! That's why we're proud to be a dog-friendly pub, welcoming well-behaved dogs in both our cozy indoor spaces and our charming outdoor seating area. Dogs are welcome inside the bar area, in the restaurant, in the garden and in our hotel rooms — with water bowls available and dedicated dog meals on the menu. Stanford Dingley is surrounded by scenic walking routes, with nearby villages such as Pangbourne and Streatley offering additional riverside walks.

Families are just as welcome: a children's play area, football goals, table tennis, pool and darts, a seasonal bouncy castle (weather permitting), and kids eat free during school holidays.
